blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 169 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 11, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DCBO & MRNA lead 169 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 29 Canadian and 140 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 11, 2026) found 169 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 29 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 13 of them new to the list this week. Docebo Inc. (DCBO) leads with a +94% six-month return, and Consumer Discretionary is the most represented sector with 5 names.

In the U.S., 140 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 39 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +406% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 37 names.
